details:
IOS Build: 2025.4.1-1749-45d5c1e5bb-Release

Quest (3 standalone) Build: 2025.4.1-1749-43b9271d4f-Release

This issue has been around for past few weeks and I have tried a lot of debugging and testing to try and find the issue and come to the conclusion it's an internal issue that VRChat has to fix them selves.

It is very temperamental and will sometimes work then other times not with the root cause being the resolver they are using with it sometimes not existing at all on the device until a few re-starts then it will suddenly appear and work then disappear again next time you start VRChat.

I do know on Windows they download yt-dlp.exe every time VRChat launches in the background so maybe they are trying to do the same here and it's failing to download, unsure and unfortunately because they do not log this action anywhere I am unable to find any log of it myself. (This is tested and proven by both deleting it as well as replacing it with the original release from github, both cases it would delete the old version and place the new vrchat downloaded one in it's place.)
